title: Equity-to-EV bridge with a convertible inside the diluted shares (IFRS)

rubric.text: The response should exclude the convertible bond from debt because its shares are already in the diluted count, and should not add lease liabilities twice.

expert_notes: EV = 1,200 + 380 bank + 180 leases + 55 NCI - 210 cash - 45 associates = 1,560 (convertible excluded; 'total borrowings' already contains the leases). 6.5x 300 = 1,950; equity 1,590; 53.00 per share.
